system.description:
You breathe a bolt of dragon like flame at a target within range. Make a ranged ninjutsu attack dealing 3d10+3 Fire damage on a hit, and forcing the effected creature to make a Constitution saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Dazzled on a failed save as the flash of heat and light overwhelms them.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and

increase the damage by 1d10+1. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase the number of attacks you can make with this jutsu by +1. You must target different creatures with each attack. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Dazzled inflicted by +1. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, if you target a body of sitting water occupying a space no larger than a 15-foot cube, you evaporate all the water contained within. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the ranks of Dazzled inflicted by +1.
